info.description:
Complete API collection for the Masar ride-sharing platform (Driver Flow Audit reorganization, 2026-08-01).

Base URL: {{base_url}} (default http://localhost:8000/api).

## Folder organization
- **Auth (shared)** — registration, login, tokens, forgot password, current user.
- **Driver** — Profile & Vehicle, Trip Management, Dashboard, Bookings, Communication, Ratings & Reviews, Complaints, Penalties, Notifications, Subscription & Earnings.
- **Passenger** — Trip Discovery, Booking, Tracking, Ratings, Complaints, Request Board, Favorites.
- **Admin** — Subscription Management, Verification Queue, Users Management, Trip Moderation, Arbitration, Penalties, Reports & Analytics.

## Notes
- Requests marked **PROPOSED** (in the description) are not implemented yet; their response examples are proposed designs.
- Every request carries a success + error example.
- Token-setting tests on registration/login flows populate {{access_token}}/{{refresh_token}} automatically.
- Error envelope: `{ "status": "error", "message": "...", "code": "..." }`.

- `personalImageWithId` *(number, required)* — image ID of a selfie holding the ID.

request.description:
Create a subscription plan. Returns `201` with the plan. `plan_id` is not captured automatically — copy it into the `plan_id` collection variable.

Requires role `admin`.

**Body fields**
- `name` *(string, required)* — plan name, max 100 chars.
- `period_days` *(number, required)* — plan length in days, positive integer.
- `percentage_cut` *(string, optional, default 0)* — commission percentage deducted at trip completion, decimal 0–100 (e.g. `"8.00"`).
- `cost` *(string, optional, default 0)* — price of the plan, decimal ≥ 0 (e.g. `"100.00"`).
- `status` *(string, optional, nullable)* — plan tag. Options: `most_requested` | `frequent` | `popular` (or `null`).
- `features` *(array, optional)* — list of feature strings, max 200 chars each.
- `is_free` *(boolean, optional, default false)* — whether this is the free plan. Options: `true` | `false`. Only one free plan may be active at a time (`409 FREE_PLAN_EXISTS`).
- `free_offer` *(object, required when `is_free: true`)* — `{ "type": "trips" | "credit", "value": number }`.

**Free plan example body**
```json
{
  "name": "Free Trial",
  "period_days": 30,
  "percentage_cut": "0.00",
  "cost": "0.00",
  "features": [],
  "is_free": true,
  "free_offer": { "type": "trips", "value": 5 }
}
```
